title: ヴィクトリアマイルの後に・先輩

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I manage to produce a great result in the Victoria Mile!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And it turns out Sweep was actually worried about me, despite all the harsh things she said. Seeing a smile on Sweep's face makes me happy too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Trainer… It's thanks to you that I made it this far, despite all the doubts I struggled with along the way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You're the ultimate partner! Let's become Legendary Princess and Legendary Trainer from Princess Fighter together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next is the Takarazuka Kinen! I'm ready to run wild! Howl, Princess☆Buster!
